text:
Maria G: FYI customer reported timeouts and massive p95/p99 jump after yesterday's tokenizer push for solace-3. p95 ~ 880ms -> 3.6s, p99 > 8s for long-context calls.

Devon L: ugh. Which deploy rolled? any recent batching/tokenizer changes? :eyes:

Maria G: deploy-bot shows `solace-tokenizer v1.2.0` merged and rolled at 2025-11-06T03:44Z. Problem started ~03:50Z. Happening on both hosted and dedicated for requests > 32k chars. Customer sample attached below.

Devon L: can you paste a minimal repro curl and a short log snippet from the request?

Maria G: repro (sanitized):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"solace-3","input":"<long_document>...~70k chars...","stream":false,"timeout_ms":12000}'
```

Log snippet from the host handling that request (timestamps local):
```
[03:50:12.102] request_id=abc123 starting tokenization
[03:50:13.014] tokenizer.apply_span: input_len_chars=70234, tokens_out=18890, time_ms=900
[03:50:13.915] kv_cache_lookup: seq_len=18890, hit=false, fallback_to_full_encode=true
[03:50:14.012] encoder.forward: time_ms=1500
[03:50:15.520] response_sent status=200 total_time_ms=3418
```

Maria G: note tokenizer time ~900ms vs prior ~140ms for same input. KV cache looks cold due to changed token boundaries (many subtokens shifted).

Henry K: I also picked up spike in batch window on the serving pool around that time (batching wait increased from 8ms -> 60ms). Could be interaction: tokenizer slower -> requests wait longer and batching grows -> encoders get overloaded -> higher tail.

Tara S: @Devon L @Henry K possible quick mitigations we can try: 1) route `solace-3` traffic to `solace-3-legacy-tokenizer` (we still have old variant), 2) reduce `max_batch_wait_ms` to 10ms for canary pool, 3) enable stronger prefix caching for long contexts. Any objections?

Devon L: +1 to routing to legacy tokenizer as emergency rollback. Also, add a temporary rule to rate-limit requests with char_count > 50k to avoid saturating.

Maria G: did a quick test by routing a single canary host to legacy tokenizer and re-running the curl: result: p95 ~ 720ms, p99 ~ 1100ms (much better).

Anil P: long-term: tokenizer change introduced a new subword merge heuristic (v1.2.0) that breaks alignment with KV cache chunking. We need to either make tokenizer chunk-boundary stable or version KV chunk keys with tokenizer hash. I can own a short design doc but will take a few days.

Devon L: For immediate triage, engineering action items:
- Roll traffic for hosted customers to `solace-3-legacy-tokenizer` (canary -> full)
- Reduce `max_batch_wait_ms` on solace pools to 10ms and lower `max_batch_size` for long-ctx routes
- Add short-term throttle for >50k char requests (soft 429 after queue length threshold)
- Add telemetry: per-request tokenizer_time_ms, kv_cache_hit boolean, tokenizer_version header

Henry K: I'll push the batching config change and the canary route. Will monitor CPU/GPU tail.

deploy-bot: Deployment `route-adjustment/solace-legacy-canary` started by Henry K at 2025-11-06T04:12Z.

Maria G: customer confirmed traffic now hitting legacy tokenizer canary and latency dropped on their samples. They are still sensitive to p99 but reported fewer timeouts.

Tara S: great. Let's capture repro artifacts and file an incident follow-up with rollout timeline, exact tokenizer diff, and a regression test that runs the top 20 long documents through new tokenizer + kv_cache simulation.

Anil P: I'll draft the regression test and add a CI job that simulates KV alignment with tokenizer outputs. Plan to have a spec by EOD tomorrow.

Devon L: owner for rollback if legacy canary doesn't hold: Henry K. Owner for long-term fix: Anil P. Owner for customer comms: Maria G.

Maria G: adding final notes: observed root cause = tokenizer subword boundary change causing KV cache miss pattern + batch-window cascade. Short-term mitigation = route to legacy tokenizer + batching throttle. Medium-term = tokenizer-chunk-stability or KV-key versioning. Closing this thread once incident doc is posted. :white_check_mark:
